description: Adds a domain to the signed-in user's TLDix tracking list so they get expiry alerts. Looks the domain up first; fails with a clear message if it is not registered or the plan's domain limit is reached. Adding a domain that is already tracked changes nothing.

alert_days.description: Days before expiry to send email alerts. Defaults to all of 60, 30, 14, 7, 3 and 1.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com. A URL or www. prefix is accepted and stripped.

name: add_domain
title: Track a domain
